title: Regression: cannot use `Ctrl+click` to jump to a property/function of a preload scene
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.beta2.official [551ce8d47]- 
- Reproducible in v4.5.stable.official [876b29033]
- Not reproducible in v4.5.beta5.official [c81fd6c51]
- Not reproducible in v4.5.beta1.official [46c495ca2]
- Not reproducible in v4.5.dev5.official [64b09905c]
- Not reproducible in v4.5.dev4.official [209a446e3]
- Not reproducible in v4.5.dev3.official [55fc6e73f]
- Not reproducible in v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]
- Not reproducible in v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7680) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads) - 47.84 GiB memory

### Issue description

It seems that a regression happend in v4.5.stable.official [876b29033].

In 4.4 or 4.5.beta:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bcee229b-5a6c-4b60-8c29-ae6dc8666d7d

In 4.5.stable.official or 4.6:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/484c169a-11c6-479f-a0b9-d0c0625f9aeb

### Steps to reproduce

N/A
